subject: microbiology
title: Monoclonal Antibodies, Hybridoma and Complement Pathways I

steps.tx: **Monoclonal antibodies** are one clone's single specificity product, uniform in a way polyclonal antisera never are, powering diagnostics (pregnancy kits, blood grouping, ELISA capture) and the therapeutic antibody era of the pharmacology lessons. Their uniformity is also their limit: one epitope, escapable by variation.
steps.say: One clone, one epitope, identical molecules: uniformity is the invention.

right.title: Polyclonal contrast
points: Antitoxins and anti thymocyte globulin heritage

steps.tx: The **hybridoma** method (Kohler and Milstein 1975) fuses antibody producing B cells with immortal myeloma partners, selects hybrids in HAT medium (myeloma lacks HGPRT, B cells die naturally, only fusions survive aminopterin blockade), clones single producers and screens supernatants for the wanted specificity. Nobel honoured, it industrialised antibody specificity.
steps.say: Fuse a mortal producer to an immortal tumour, select in HAT, clone the winner.

nodes.label: Mouse immunised, spleen B cells harvested

steps.tx: **HAT selection logic** deserves its mechanism: aminopterin blocks de novo nucleotide synthesis, salvage enzymes (HGPRT, thymidine kinase) rescue cells using hypoxanthine and thymidine, myeloma partners lack HGPRT, unfused B cells senesce, so hybridomas alone inherit both rescue and immortality. Modern recombinant expression (CHO cells, phage display) inherited hybridoma's clones without its mice for most new drugs.
steps.say: HAT starves every cell except the fusion; rescue enzymes are the selection's arithmetic.

left.title: Selection arithmetic
points: B cell parent mortal: only hybrids persist

right.title: Modern successors
points: Single B cell cloning (rabies, HIV antibodies)

steps.tx: The **classical complement pathway** ignites when C1q reads antibody Fc on antigen (IgM best, IgG1 and 3), C1r and C1s activate, C4 and C2 build the C3 convertase (C4b2a), and the cascade converges on C3, the system's traffic circle. Immune complexes and CRP can also engage C1q, which is why classical consumption (low C4) flags complex disease.
steps.say: Antibody plus C1q starts classical; C4 falls when complexes burn this road.

left.title: Classical sequence
points: C1q binds clustered Fc (or CRP, complexes)
C4 and C2 cleaved to C4b2a convertase

right.title: Classical signatures
points: Low C4 with low C3: immune complex consumption
CH50 screens whole classical to terminal
Early component deficiency: lupus like disease

steps.tx: The **alternative pathway** needs no antibody: spontaneous C3 tick over deposits C3b on surfaces, factor B and D build its convertase (C3bBb), properdin stabilises, and host regulators (factor H, membrane MCP and DAF) spare self while microbes lacking regulators amplify. This is innate complement from the earlier lesson with its proteins named.
steps.say: Alternative complement is a fire that self surfaces extinguish and microbes cannot.

left.title: Alternative sequence
points: Factor B and D assemble convertase

right.title: Self protection
points: Factor H and I degrade C3b on self
Regulator mutation: atypical HUS and C3 glomerulopathy

steps.tx: **Complement effectors** divide labour cleanly: C3b opsonises, C3a and C5a inflame and chemotax (anaphylatoxins), C5b begins the membrane attack complex, and breakdown products (iC3b, C3d) tag antigen for B cell co stimulation (lowering activation thresholds, vaccines borrow this). Each fragment has a receptor and an examination pairing.
steps.say: C3b feeds phagocytes, C5a summons them, C5b drills the membrane.

left.title: Fragment jobs
points: C3d: B cell co receptor tag (CR2)

right.title: Clinical gauges
points: Low C3 and C4 patterns localise pathway use
C5a in sepsis and dialysis reactions
Soluble MAC in thrombotic microangiopathy work

steps.tx: **Complement deficiencies** fingerprint pathways by infection: early classical (C1, C4, C2) lupus like and encapsulated bacteria, C3 catastrophic pyogenic infection, properdin and terminal (C5 to C9) recurrent Neisseria (meningococcus and gonococcus disseminated), regulators (factor H, C1 inhibitor) kidney and angioedema diseases. A teenager with second meningococcal episode earns a CH50.
steps.say: Recurrent meningococcus means check the terminal pathway; the organism names the defect.

left.title: Deficiency phenotypes
points: C2 commonest classical deficiency, lupus leaning
C5 to C9, properdin: Neisseria recurrence
Factor D and B: rare alternative failures

steps.tx: **Complement therapeutics** now span blockade (eculizumab and ravulizumab anti C5 in PNH and atypical HUS, meningococcal vaccination mandatory before), C1 inhibitor replacement in hereditary angioedema, and complement biomarkers guiding lupus and transplant rejection. The cascade this module assembles has become a formulary.
steps.say: Block C5 and vaccinate against meningococcus first; the pathway you block names the vaccine.

left.title: Blockade territory
points: Anti C5: PNH, atypical HUS, myasthenia niches
C1 inhibitor concentrates: HAE attacks and prophylaxis
Avacopan C5a receptor in ANCA vasculitis

right.title: Blockade obligations
points: Complement levels do not guide blockade simply
